title: Lightly Cured Japanese Baby New Potatoes Gratin
description: A cultured and creamy Japanese dish featuring baby new potatoes with a yuzu cure, perfect for a comforting meal. This Mediterranean-friendly recipe combines the best of East and West.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and yuzu juice, tossing to coat.
Let the potatoes sit for 30 minutes to allow the yuzu cure to take effect.
Drain the potatoes and rinse them with cold water.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the heavy cream to the saucepan and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the cream sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter or cooking spray.
Create a layer of potatoes in the baking dish, followed by a layer of cream sauce and a sprinkle of cheese.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients have been used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Sprinkle the chopped scallions and black pepper over the top of the gratin.
